title: Detector YOLO Output
description: JSON output schema for detector/sahi_infer.py. Governs the interface between the YOLO detector and the quantity-takeoff pipeline.

image.description: Path to the source image file

preds.description: List of detections after non-maximum suppression

cls.description: Class index. 0=door, 1=window. Must be within CLASS_NAMES bounds.

x0.description: Bounding box left edge in pixels (absolute, not tile-relative)

y0.description: Bounding box top edge in pixels

x1.description: Bounding box right edge in pixels; must be >= x0

y1.description: Bounding box bottom edge in pixels; must be >= y0
